objective: Test whether the primary 8+8 MMLU result depends on pooling only the final valid prompt token.
design_change: Replace last_valid prompt pooling with mean_valid pooling; preserve the model revision, tasks, prompts, generation settings, batch size, sample count, sample IDs, phases, and storage dtype.

matched_mmlu_8x8_confirmatory.role: Post-review pooling sensitivity on the unchanged primary task panel.
matched_mmlu_8x8_confirmatory.claim_limit: A difference identifies estimator sensitivity to prompt-position pooling, not a distinct model mechanism.

promotion_gates: A real tracker-off/on smoke must preserve responses, scores, and token counts.
The newly frozen sample-selection file must match the parent's task-wise sample IDs before model loading.
All records must be finite, exact, complete, prefill-only, and marked mean_valid.
Selection-aware inference must repeat layer-stream selection under every balanced task assignment.
claim_limit: This is a post-review one-model sensitivity analysis. It does not establish cross-model pooling robustness or causal localization.
